findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_site, generate_fix_prompt, audit_site, audit_url, get_audit, get_api_x402_audit · Private data: add_site, search_console, domain_status, check_domain, audit_url · Public sink: add_site, generate_fix_prompt, ai_search_visibility, domain_status, audit_site, run_tab, get_api_x402_audit · Destructive: ai_search_visibility, audit_url, run_tab, get_api_x402_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_site, generate_fix_prompt, audit_site, audit_url, get_audit, get_api_x402_audit · Private data: add_site, search_console, domain_status, check_domain, audit_url · Public sink: add_site, generate_fix_prompt, ai_search_visibility, domain_status, audit_site, run_tab, get_api_x402_audit · Destructive: ai_search_visibility, audit_url, run_tab, get_api_x402_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
